title: Practice 12: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **недоставать → недостаёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**осуществляться → осуществляется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**шутить → шутишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: So far it has been an exciting year.
exercises.why: **выдаваться → выдаётся** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**владеть → владеет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We, the Japanese, now feed ourselves with rice.
exercises.why: **кормиться → кормимся** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Само присутствие тёмных рыцарей ___ (утраивать) боевую мощь нашей армии.
exercises.prompt: The very presence of the dark knights triples the battle strength of our army.
exercises.why: **утраивать → утраивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**проверять → проверяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Crowns are inherited, kingdoms are earned.
exercises.why: **наследоваться → наследуются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**намекать → намекаешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Каждый француз в среднем ___ (съедать) полбагета в день.
exercises.prompt: On average, every French person consumes half a baguette a day.
exercises.why: **съедать → съедает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The living room adjoins the dining room.
exercises.why: **примыкать → примыкает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Летучие мыши ___ (использовать) ультразвук, чтобы определять местонахождение препятствий.
exercises.prompt: The bats use ultrasound to locate obstacles.
exercises.why: **использовать → используют** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm filling in for Tom again.
exercises.why: **подменять → подменяю** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**приказывать → приказываешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**следить → следит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**наступать → Наступает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I bet I can do better than Tom.
exercises.why: **спорить → Спорим** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**вставать → встаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**грузить → грузите** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
